# kicad-happy (DSH edition)

> AI-powered design review skills for KiCad electronics projects

A DSH-native suite of 12 skills that turn a DeepSeek Harness agent into an
electronics design assistant. Structured Python analysis scripts (zero
dependencies, Python 3.10+ stdlib only) for KiCad 5-10 projects.

Capabilities: schematic analysis (40+ subcircuit detectors), PCB layout
review, EMC pre-compliance (44 rules), SPICE simulation, thermal analysis,
component sourcing (DigiKey/Mouser/LCSC/element14), BOM management,
manufacturing prep (JLCPCB/PCBWay), and professional documentation
generation.

Install: clone this repo and open it as a DeepSeek Harness workspace (the
`.dsh/skills/` link auto-registers all skills), or symlink skills into
`~/.dsh/skills/` for global availability. See `README.md` and
`install-guidance.md`.

## Skills

- [Hub — kicad-happy](https://github.com/MaximGorbunov/kicad-happy-dsh/blob/main/skills/hub/SKILL.md): orchestrates the other skills for full reviews and multi-unit work (subagents, workflows, present, schedules)
- [Schematic Analysis](https://github.com/MaximGorbunov/kicad-happy-dsh/blob/main/skills/kicad/SKILL.md): parse .kicad_sch files, detect 40+ subcircuit types, compute voltages/frequencies/currents, validate component values against datasheets
- [EMC Pre-Compliance](https://github.com/MaximGorbunov/kicad-happy-dsh/blob/main/skills/emc/SKILL.md): 44 rule checks across 18 categories — ground planes, decoupling, switching harmonics, PDN impedance, diff pairs, board edge radiation
- [SPICE Simulation](https://github.com/MaximGorbunov/kicad-happy-dsh/blob/main/skills/spice/SKILL.md): auto-generated testbenches for 17 subcircuit types, Monte Carlo tolerance analysis, multi-simulator support
- [BOM Management](https://github.com/MaximGorbunov/kicad-happy-dsh/blob/main/skills/bom/SKILL.md): multi-supplier pricing, order file export, lifecycle auditing
- [DigiKey](https://github.com/MaximGorbunov/kicad-happy-dsh/blob/main/skills/digikey/SKILL.md): OAuth 2.0 API integration, datasheet sync, part search
- [Mouser](https://github.com/MaximGorbunov/kicad-happy-dsh/blob/main/skills/mouser/SKILL.md): API key auth, part search, pricing
- [LCSC](https://github.com/MaximGorbunov/kicad-happy-dsh/blob/main/skills/lcsc/SKILL.md): free jlcsearch community API, no auth required
- [element14](https://github.com/MaximGorbunov/kicad-happy-dsh/blob/main/skills/element14/SKILL.md): Newark/Farnell API, international sourcing
- [JLCPCB](https://github.com/MaximGorbunov/kicad-happy-dsh/blob/main/skills/jlcpcb/SKILL.md): BOM/CPL format, assembly constraints, basic vs extended parts
- [PCBWay](https://github.com/MaximGorbunov/kicad-happy-dsh/blob/main/skills/pcbway/SKILL.md): turnkey assembly rules, MPN-based sourcing
